newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end lower, smaller issues grab focus.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end lower, smaller issues grab focus.

text.p: Philippine shares closed slightly lower on Tuesday after trading in a tight band with second and thirdliners stealing the limelight, traders said.

Diversified Securities executive vice-president Jose Ricardo Garcia said the market's mixed behaviour was in part due nervousness ahead of an expected decision by the Supreme Court on whether to uphold its decision not to allow a petition by a group seeking to scrap the Presidency's six-year term limit.
The main index ended 3.26 points lower at 2,775.11. Turnover was improved at 2.0 billion pesos from the previous 945 million.
